facts.condition: A concrete pair of binary auxiliary channels admits a checkable dual witness within the portfolio’s accepted auxiliary-receiver converse, thereby furnishing a rigorous numerical ceiling on the canonical sum rate.

assumptions: The previously accepted auxiliary-receiver converse interface is valid for the canonical half-skew channel.
The manifested certificate is interpreted under the exact-arithmetic and directed-rounding semantics used by its accepted judgment.
No optimality of the chosen auxiliary channels and no matching achievable rate are assumed.
